source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
	ENTITY_ID
	,ENTITY_TYPE
	,INTEREST_IND
	,INTEREST_TYPE
	,SERIAL_NUM
	,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
	,PRODUCT
	,PRODUCT_FOR_INT_RATE
	,DIFF_PRODUCT
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(START_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS START_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(END_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS END_DATE
	,INT_TABLE_CODE
	,INT_VERSION
	,INT_METHOD
	,FULL_RATE
	,DIFF_RATE
	,INTEREST_AMOUNT
	,FIXED_INT_PER_ANNUM
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LAST_COMP_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LAST_COMP_DATE
	,LAST_COMP_AMOUNT
	,SUPERCEDE_FLG
	,BASE_DAYS_IN_A_YEAR
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(REF_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS REF_DATE
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,CRNCY_CODE
	,TS_CNT
	,INT_APPL_FLG
	,DEF_APPL_INT_RATE
	,DEF_APPL_INT_AMT
	,BASE_RATE
	,BANK_ID
	,INT_AMOUNT_MODIFIED
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LAST_COMP_DATE_CR, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LAST_COMP_DATE_CR
	,LAST_COMP_AMOUNT_CR
	,INT_APPL_FLG_CR
	,WTAX_AMOUNT_SCOPE_FLG
	,ITAX_FOR_FLOOR_LIMIT_FLG
	,WTAX_PCNT
	,WTAX_FLOOR_LIMIT
	,LAST_COMP_TAX
	,TAX_AMOUNT
	,WTAX_FOR_CR_COMP
	,PROD_CALC_METHOD
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM D360.STG_DEP_INTERESTDETAILSTABLE
